articleTitle: An Improved ResNet Algorithm Based On CBAM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Flower recognition has important application value in the field of flower cultivation and planting. As a kind of fine-grained image recognition, the traditional flower recognition has the problem of low recognition accuracy. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a neural network algorithm of ResNet structure that integrates CBAM mechanism, and adds residual blocks of attention modules to the second layer to the fifth layer of the ResNet structure. Finally, the results are output through adaptive average pooling and full connection layer. Experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of the model is close to 98% even when the recognition is difficult and there are few training data. Compared with the traditional deep learning model, the model proposed in this paper significantly improves the recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Forest Fire Detection Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to make early warning on forest fire, this paper proposes a new method that combines classification model and objection model for forest fire recognition, and builds a fire warning system based on this method. Firstly, the algorithm optimized on VGG network, and introduced transfer learning method to train smoke recognition model and flame recognition model. Secondly, consider the difficulty of small flame recognition in the early stage of fire, introduced YOLO network for fire detection, and optimization on it to improve the ability of feature extraction and multi-scale feature fusion. Finally, made use of decision tree method for joint decision of fire warning by results of classification and detection. Experiments show that the mAP of this method is 96.5%, and the detection speed is 30.9FPS, which meets the real-time requirements of fire detection.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Gradient Descent Algorithm in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The gradient descent algorithm is a type of optimization algorithm that is widely used to solve machine learning algorithm model parameters. Through continuous iteration, it obtains the gradient of the objective function, gradually approaches the optimal solution of the objective function, and finally obtains the minimum loss function and related parameters. The gradient descent algorithm is frequently used in the solution process of logical regression, which is a common binary classification approach. This paper compares and analyzes the differences between batch gradient descent and its derivative algorithms — stochastic gradient descent algorithm and mini- batch gradient descent algorithm in terms of iteration number, loss function through experiments, and provides some suggestions on how to pick the best algorithm for the logistic regression binary task in machine learning.

articleTitle: A Defect Detection Method Based on Improved Mask R-CNN for Wafer Maps
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Pattern recognition of defects in wafer drawing is very important to determine the root cause of production defects, which can provide insights for the production improvement of wafer plants. In wafer manufacturing process, there will be mixed defects, detection of mixed defects is much more complex. Deep learning method has become a good choice to solve the problem of complex pattern recognition. In this paper, an improved Mask R-CNN model for wafer defect map is proposed. The ability of small target recognition is improved by fusing residual network and feature pyramid network, and the target feature can be fully extracted in the shallow model, so that the efficiency of feature extraction is improved. Secondly, an improved non-maximum suppression (NMS) algorithm is added to solve the error detection problem caused by traditional algorithms. The experimental results show that the improved Mask R-CNN model is superior to the conventional model, and has better recognition effect for small targets and shallow models. Secondly, the improved NMS algorithm is added to improve the detection precision.

articleTitle: Fault Arc Detection Based on Time and Frequency Domain Analysis and Radom Forest
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The Low voltage AC power grid is the most widely used power grid, but also the most day-to-day life-oriented power grid. The damage caused by fault arcs in low voltage AC networks is also incalculable. By using the self-made arc generator to simulate the generation of low voltage fault arcs, the current signals of 8 kinds of fault arcs are obtained. Time domain features such as average and variance of each load current waveform are extracted, and then the current waveform is passed through the Fourier transform to obtain such features as variance frequency ratio in its frequency domain. Through the analysis of decision tree and random forest, random forest is selected as the classification algorithm of fault arc detection, then the accurate load identification and fault identification are carried out by using random forest. A total of 21907 current state information is collected. The results show that the recognition rate of this algorithm is 100% for light bulb and electric fan, and 99% for other electric apparatus. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed detection algorithm.

articleTitle: An Improved Artificial Bee Colony with Self-Adaptive Strategies and Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Artificial bee colony algorithm (ABC) has been becoming a hot topic of swarm intelligence. Artificial bee colony algorithm shows great advantages in solving path problems. There still exist some shortcomings in basic ABC algorithm, such as low convergence rate and easily falling into local optimization. Hence, an improved Artificial Bee Colony algorithm is proposed in this paper. In the improved Artificial Bee Colony, self-adaptive strategies for updating food source is introduced to ensure time and accuracy of algorithm. The proposed algorithm is also applied to the traveling salesman problem. Experiments show the effectiveness of improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Hyperparameter Optimization for SOC Estimation by LSTM with Internal Resistance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: State of charge (SOC) is an important indicator to describe battery performance. However, most of the training input data for SOC estimation using deep learning algorithm do not consider the battery internal resistance. In this paper, a method for SOC estimation of lithium-ion batteries based on the LSTM neural network is proposed, and the battery voltage, current, temperature and internal resistance are taken as the training input data of the LSTM model. When the correlation function is determined, the influence of different hyperparameters of the LSTM model with battery internal resistance as the training data on the SOC estimation results is analyzed and compared to determine the optimal setting of the hyperparameters of the model. The experimental results show that the model with the battery resistance as the training input data has higher accuracy. On this basis, the LSTM model with appropriate hyperparameters has the advantages of high accuracy and fast convergence in SOC estimation.

articleTitle: SLAM Method Based on Multi-Sensor Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: SLAM is a key technology in the field of mobile robot. However, it is difficult to meet the requirements of positioning accuracy by using single sensor to locate and navigate for a mobile robot. Multi-sensor information fusion technology has become an important method to solve the problem of mobile robot positioning and navigation. By establishing information fusion model, building sensor experimental platform such as laser radar, ultrasonic ranging module and monocular camera, based on the laser RBPF-SLAM algorithm, a SLAM algorithm based on multi-sensor information fusion is proposed. The mobile robot can locate and construct road sign map at the same time. The laser RBPF-SLAM positioning and monocular visual positioning are advanced by using the information fusion model Information fusion under the maximum posterior probability criterion. Through experiments, the accuracy, effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Design of Tracked Agricultural Robots for Apple Orchards
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To solve the problems of heavy protection tasks and low operational intelligence in China's apple production, this paper designs a crawler-type agricultural robot dedicated to the apple orchard, which is easy to obtain growth information and plant protection of fruit trees in apple orchards. Based on the working environment of the agricultural robot, the parameter indexes are designed; the motion model of the lifting sprayer is established and the length dimension of the lifting frame is obtained; the parameter requirements of the robot's driving motor are derived based on its force and motion analysis; the control system of the robot is designed using the control flow chart. The simulation results show that the structure and control system of the robot meet the design requirements. The design is also of reference value for the design of other fruit tree protection robots.

articleTitle: Unbalanced Data Set Classification Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: When a data set contains different categories of data and the number of elements contained in the categories differs greatly, we call this type of data set an unbalanced data set. When classifying imbalanced data sets, it is difficult to correctly classify important minority data using traditional algorithms. How to better classify minority data has become a difficult point. The use of convolutional neural networks can solve this point well. Therefore, the purpose of this article is to study the classification of unbalanced data sets based on convolutional neural networks. This article first analyzes the structure and algorithm of the convolutional neural network. Combining with the current research status of imbalanced data set classification, the difficulties and performance evaluation methods are discussed. Finally, the classification of imbalanced data sets is researched and analyzed with convolutional neural network. This paper systematically expounds the classification model of convolutional neural network, the computational complexity of convolutional neural network, and the analysis of parameters and models of convolutional neural network applied to the classification of imbalanced data sets. And use observation method, comparative method and other research methods to carry out experimental investigation on the research of this article. Experimental research shows that the CNN algorithm has better precision and recall results for different data set samples in the classification process than the SVM algorithm and the K-means algorithm, and the classification is more accurate.

articleTitle: A Trajectory Generation Method for Quadrotor and Cable Suspended Load Stability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In this paper, a trajectory generation strategy that is conducive to quadrotor and load stability are presented for a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with cable suspended load. First, the Euler-Lagrange formulation is used to obtain the dynamic model of the system, where the integrated dynamics of the quadrotor and cable suspended load are considered. Second, the differential flatness is used to generate trajectory that is conducive to quadrotor and load stability. Finally, the system is divided into two parts: a full-drive part and an under-actuation part, and a sliding mode controller is designed to restrain the attitude change caused by the swing of the load. Numerical simulation results using quadrotor and load attitude change are shown to evaluate the proposed control law.

articleTitle: Image Style Transfer Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Image style transfer refers to the transformation of the style of image, so that the image details are retained to the maximum extent while the style is transferred. Aiming at the problem of low clarity of style transfer images generated by CycleGAN network, this paper improves the CycleGAN network. In this paper, the network model of auto-encoder and variational auto-encoder is added to the structure. The encoding part of the auto-encoder is used to extract image content features, and the variational auto-encoder is used to extract style features. At the same time, the generating network of the model in this paper uses first to adjust the image size and then perform the convolution operation to replace the traditional deconvolution operation. The discriminating network uses a multi-scale discriminator to force the samples generated by the generating network to be more realistic and approximate the target image, so as to improve the effect of image style transfer.

articleTitle: Stable Platform Research on Control Method of Fully Rotary Steerable Drilling Tool
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Rotary steering drilling is a drilling technique in which the bit's drilling path is controlled by an electronic control device (steering tool) located near the bit as the drill column rotates. The guidance tool's center is the stability control platform, which plays a critical role in guidance control. The effect of eccentric action torque on platform motion is studied using the simulation method, and the PID control method is proposed to resolve the problem that large-scale variation of drilling fluid flow affects the control efficiency of the platform. A feed-forward compensation method for turbine motor voltage is proposed to address the problem that PID control can only achieve stable control in a narrow flow range. The digital analog hybrid device structure is built to realize the power, and the signal operation circuit of voltage feed-forward control is designed and realized, according to the concept of voltage feed-forward angle feedback control process. The circuit's test results show that its signal operation accuracy meets control criteria, and its temperature characteristics meet the needs of underground workers.

articleTitle: Design and Research on Key Modules of Smart Campus Network Cloud Platform Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the concept of smart campus being put forward, coupled with the continuous in-depth construction of educational information in higher education, the construction of smart campus is facing increasing challenges. At present, more and more information and data is generated to be processed in the construction of smart campus. So how to collect, process and utilize these resources effectively has become one of the urgent problems. In this context, this paper conducts the research and design on the key modules of the smart campus network cloud platform. Firstly, we use the literature research method to explain the advantages of the smart campus network cloud platform and its key modules. Then we test the network cloud platform resource scheduling algorithm, and the experimental results show that the Hadoop default FIFO scheduling algorithm achieves the best performance among the three algorithms. With the same data memory, the running time is only 248s. Finally, the key modules of the smart campus network cloud platform is designed.

articleTitle: Improved Method of Garbage Classification Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Garbage classification is an important part of resource recycling and utilization, which can improve the utilization rate of resource recycling and reduce environmental pollution. Due to the wide variety of MSW and the lack of a unified standard for specific classification, most people will have difficulty in choosing MSW in practical operation. Traditional image classification methods have been difficult to meet the requirements. We can build an accurate classification model based on deep learning technology and use technical means to improve the living environment. In this paper, deep learning algorithm is used to identify and classify garbage, which can not only improve the efficiency of garbage classification, but also improve the accuracy of garbage classification. Mainly studies the garbage classification model based on CNN, methods of using the migration study selected suitable for network model of garbage classification in this paper, and then use the model integration methods such as increase the generalization ability of the model, finally using distillation technology will big model learned knowledge transferred to small in the model, the loss of lesser accuracy at the same time, improve efficiency and prediction accuracy of model prediction, To quickly and accurately identify the garbage type effect.

articleTitle: Active Collision Avoidance Control Based on Vehicle Emergency Braking
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: When a vehicle is braking because of collision avoidance under the extreme conditions, such as braking on the lower adhesion coefficient road with high-speed, vehicle stability is difficult to be obtained. In order to take active collision avoidance during the emergency braking with high-speed on the lower adhesion coefficient road, a controller is built based on vehicle lateral and longitudinal dynamic coupling. A certain vehicle model of C-Class is built to analyze the vehicle braking stability at collision avoidance condition. At the same time, the fuzzy rules of PID model and the control strategies of the dynamic coupling controller are drawn up. The vehicle stability is analyzed using the vehicle angular velocity and vehicle lateral acceleration and longitudinal acceleration, etc. based on the coupling controller. The measured results show that the proposed coupling controller improves vehicle lateral stability for active collision avoidance at the emergency braking.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Collaborative Governance Audit Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Currently, the traditional audit model has been gradually replaced by collaborative governance auditing. The effective development of collaborative governance auditing requires the construction of a big data audit platform to ensure. This article combines cloud computing related technologies, using CEPH distributed storage system, MapReduce parallel computing framework, heterogeneous computing and other technologies to try to establish a collaborative governance auditing big data platform, and analyze from the three aspects of the motivation, measures and system of the construction of the collaborative governance audit big data platform. The article divides the audit big data platform into five systems: data collection, preprocessing, storage center, analysis and visualization. The combination of collaborative governance audit and big data technology is a new attempt, with epoch-making significance and broad imagination, and provides a technical foundation for the collaborative governance audit cloud sharing platform, and provides theoretical support for the development of future big data audit work.

articleTitle: Research of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Large-scale equipment in different industries is becoming more and more electronic, complicated and integrated. In order to provide technical support for the normal operation of industrial equipment, fault diagnosis becomes extremely important. Intelligent fault diagnosis, as the name suggests, is to combine fault diagnosis and artificial intelligence theory to replace traditional fault diagnosis methods in a smarter way to obtain more accurate diagnosis results. Machine learning has become a current technical hotspot. In view of its advantages in efficiently extracting information and processing large amounts of data, more and more attention has been paid in the field of fault diagnosis. This paper systematically introduces the related concepts of machine learning and fault diagnosis, and summarizes fault diagnosis methods and applications based on support vector machines and neural networks. Finally, this paper makes a further outlook on the development of intelligent fault diagnosis technology based on machine learning.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mobile Phone Intercom App Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of instant messaging in many fields of work, this article designs an instant messaging application based on Android smartphones. The application is based on the C/S software architecture model and uses the Netty network framework to communicate between the client and the server. The system mainly realizes that the user enters the user data in the login interface, and then enters the intercom interface after the system verifies the information. The user can select the channel to enter the designated channel and talk in the channel without interference between the channels., The user can choose the channel arbitrarily, and can exit after the intercom. And users can invite other online users to enter a temporary channel for intercom communication. System: The client uses Android Studio, the server uses Eclipse, and the MYSQL database is used to store system data. The voice input of the client uses the AudioRecord class and AudioTrack class for real-time voice communication. The client-server communication in the entire system is implemented based on the Netty network framework[1]. The use of this framework makes the entire communication process simple. The system has been developed. After logging in to the application, the user can select a channel for intercom between multiple users in the local area network. The user can use the application to save professional intercom equipment and communicate with each other using a mobile phon.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Feature Extraction Model for Source Code Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Despite the work done by academia and industry in the area of vulnerability detection, the number of vulnerabilities reported each year is still growing rapidly. Nowadays, the mainstream vulnerability detection methods mainly transform source code into an intermediate representation and then detect it by machine learning or deep learning algorithms, but the problem of high false-positive rate and negative rate is difficult to solve. This is mainly because the intermediate representation does not reflect the characteristics of the vulnerabilities well. In this paper, we propose a convolutional neural network-based feature extraction model. By extracting features from such intermediate representations of code metrics, these features are used as input to a deep learning model for vulnerability detection. By experimenting with other vulnerability detection methods under the same benchmark, our proposed model shows improvement in all evaluation metrics, with Precision and Recall reaching close to 80%, and False Positive Rate and False Negative Rate decreasing to close to 20%. Finally, we analyze the proposed method and discuss how it should be improved in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Arc Detection Method Based on FOA-GRNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The series fault arc caused by aging and damage of line insulation and poor electrical contact seriously threatens the power safety of low-voltage distribution system. Its characteristics such as low current, high temperature and strong concealment make it difficult to detect and identify. Based on this, a fault arc detection method based on wavelet features and generalized regression neural network is proposed. By building the experimental platform of fault arc, the current signals under typical resistive and inductive loads are collected, and the wave transform is used to extract the characteristics of the current signals. The training set and test set are constructed. The generalized regression neural network is optimized by the Drosophila optimization algorithm, and the smoothing factor of GRNN is optimized, so as to improve the recognition ability of the model and the smoothing factor of GRNN is optimized. Experimental results show that FOA-GRNN has better recognition accuracy and recognition rate than traditional BP network.

articleTitle: Study on the Division Method of Pipeline Robot Module
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In this paper, module division was conducted for the pipeline robot system by way of combining axiomatic design method and IDEF functional modeling method, to solve the problem of single function and repeated structure design in the pipeline robot system. This method can extract the general module and customized module in the pipeline robot system via the function-structure mapping and the relation between products and activities. In this way, the compatibility and interchangeability between components can be realized, and resource sharing formed. Different functional modules can be assembled as customized modules according to different task requirements, to realize the multi-functionalization of the pipeline robot and meet market demands.

articleTitle: Edge Servers Deployment Based on 5G Micro Base Stations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the intelligent development of augmented reality, smart home and other applications, more and more applications pursue high bandwidth, low latency and wide connectivity, so mobile edge computing technology has attracted more and more attention. Mobile edge computing will deploy the edge server closer to the user's network edge, and the user will unload the task to the server for execution, so as to reduce the task execution time and the energy consumption of the local terminal. However, people often only pay attention to the core problem of mobile edge computing: computing offload. As the first step of mobile edge computing, server deployment has received little attention. Therefore, this paper studies the deployment of edge server, and proposes an algorithm to deploy edge server in 5G micro base station. The algorithm considers the computing time of tasks and the load balance of servers, reduces the access delay of tasks and balances the load between edge servers. Simulation results show that the deployment strategy is superior to other algorithms in terms of server load and task access latency.

articleTitle: A Resource Allocation Method of Deep Reinforcement Transfer Learning in WSN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In WSN environment, aiming at the problem of multi-objective and multi constraint resource allocation, a resource allocation mathematical model is established to seek the optimal solution. The deep reinforcement transfer learning (DRTL) method is adopted by introducing reliability and the idea of transfer learning. In the process of DRTL forward transmission and backward propagation, the maximum group is selected as the optimal allocation strategy. Finally, in the same environment, we compared with ant colony and discrete particle swarm algorithm, found that it has a significant impact on energy consumption, transmission time and reliability.

articleTitle: The Research on the Promotion Path of Digital Elements to Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the era of digital economy, “digital” ushers in explosive growth “ As the micro structure of the perceptual, IOT and intelligent world, “digital” plays an important role in the production process and plays an important role in the process of value creation, and presents such economic and technological characteristics as permeability, dependence, virtual substitution, dynamic accuracy, sharing low cost and self-organization “Digital” has rapidly become a new factor of production, enabling economic growth. “Digital” changes the micro basis of economic operation, promotes structural optimization, mode innovation and institutional change, promotes the efficiency of production, organization and transaction, and improves the level of resource allocation through the mechanism of factor driving, integration and stimulation, collaborative promotion and feedback positive allocation. Under the new situation, strengthening the construction of digital infrastructure, the construction of digital elements market and the governance of digital elements are the key to guarantee the economic growth and further tap the potential value of digital elements.

articleTitle: Hough Circle Detection Method for Shaking Instruments in Drilling Field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: At present, the real-time performance of data acquisition has become the key to the development of intelligent drilling. Due to the limitation of stay wire and power supply, the stability of data transmission is not high. In view of the data cannot be collected effectively, machine vision is introduced into the drilling field to automatically judge and read the instruments, there are often fuzzy images of vibration instability in the acquired instrument images. By analyzing the reasons and rules of instrument jitter, a new scheme is proposed. The dithering image is blurred by Wiener filter, and the template matching is made for the initial frame picture. The disc and the center of the circle are obtained from the matched stable image by improved Hough transform, and then they are drawn on the deblurring image. The experiment shows that the error of the circle obtained in this scheme is more stable than the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Location of Distributed Low-Voltage Distribution Network Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: When the low-voltage distribution network breaks down, it needs to respond quickly, and the method of finding fault by manual line inspection is time-consuming and laborious. In order to solve the problem of lack of effective fault location method in low-voltage network, a fault location method based on distributed nodes is proposed. The method is based on the chaotic reflection method, set up multiple test points in the low voltage power grid, the real-time monitoring of power grids, power grid failure, contrast analysis of test results, the test point each test point is determined according to the principle of the shortest path with the shortest distance of fault point, set up by the recent test point measurements of potential fault branch collection, to determine the fault subnetwork, Then, multiple information sources in the fault subnetwork are fused to determine the specific fault branch, and the specific fault location is determined by the nearest test point. Finally, the fault detection and alarm system of the low-voltage distribution network is designed based on the power Internet of Things. Key technologies such as IED, LOLA wireless AD organization network and intelligent gateway are used to realize the collection, communication and intelligent research and judgment of global line information, and realtime monitoring and alarm reception of the mobile terminal are realized through the cloud platform.

articleTitle: Criminal Investigation Image Retrieval Based on Deep Hash Code
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: For the problem of low accuracy and efficiency in criminal investigation image retrieval tasks, proposed a retrieval method based on deep hash coding. Adopting ResNet as backbone network for feature extraction, and adding a pyramid pooling layer to enhance the quality of image features; In order to improve the retrieval efficiency, a deep hash layer is introduced to adaptively extract binary hash code for the image. By means of image-pair training method, and Combination of classification loss and contrast loss for joint learning, optimize training effect. Experiments show that the accuracy and efficiency of image retrieval by this method are significantly improved when compared with the existing benchmark algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimization of TCP NewReno Algorithm Based on Available Bandwidth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the development of new network structures, the current network environment has become complex and diverse. Traditional TCP NewReno algorithm does not have a packet loss judgment mechanism, it cannot distinguish the types of data packet loss. The noise packet loss is erroneously interpreted as the congestion packet loss, resulting in frequent jitter and long delay. We propose a new method, namely TCP NewRenoBw, to address the available bandwidth estimation. By judging the type of packet loss, it can effectively distinguish noise loss and congestion loss. Our simulation results show that TCP NewRenoBw can resist noise interference and make the transmission per unit time more stable at the same time. The throughput of TCP NewRenoBw is significantly higher than that of TCP NewReno, which achieves better bandwidth utilization and competition fairness, and improves the transmission performance of TCP in the low bandwidth and high packet loss rate network.

articleTitle: Multi Core Scheduling Algorithm Based on Affinity Node Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: List based scheduling algorithm is widely used in the field of multi-core task scheduling because of its low complexity and high efficiency. Classical list scheduling algorithm does not consider the impact of communication overhead between nodes in the node allocation stage, so it is difficult to achieve good results. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a list scheduling (ANF) algorithm based on affinity node fusion. By fusing affinity nodes of nodes in task cluster into task cluster, a better scheduling sequence is generated and better scheduling effect is obtained. Theoretical analysis shows that ANF algorithm can greatly reduce the communication overhead between related tasks and shorten the task completion time.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability of Network Data Transmission in Substation Area Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The reliability of the network transmission hold great significance for the network sampling and tripping technology of intelligent substation secondary equipment. In this paper, based on the analysis of redundancy mode's impact on the power system, the distinction between different redundancy mode and network mode of the process level are described in detail, then the intelligent substation system redundancy design scheme is put forward to achieve the network sampling and tripping in process level. Furthermore, the paper adopts the static multicast management to optimize process level transmit traffic as well as reduce the influence between different data transmission flow.

articleTitle: Design of Test Framework Based on Lightweight Operating System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Improving the quality and testing efficiency of embedded software is an important research topic at present. The existing typical open source testing frameworks are mainly for general embedded software products or general web domain software products. In view of the problems that open source testing frameworks do not meet the specific requirements of lightweight operating systems, such as low memory consumption, high energy efficiency and so on, Through the research and analysis of lightweight operating system testing technology and typical operating system architecture, a lightweight testing framework is designed. According to the counting semaphore of the system kernel, the overall test framework and the test methods of some important modules are given from the perspective of task switching time and interrupt response time in the time performance of the lightweight operating system. The correctness of the design and implementation of the test framework is verified. The test results show that the test efficiency is improved through the test framework, thus, the software quality can be further improved.

articleTitle: Research on Classification Model of BP Neural Network Based on DL Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: To accurately and quickly find out the degree of depression tendency for teenagers, so people can make timely intervention work to reduce the incidence of psychological diseases of them. In this paper, we present a BP neural network classification model based on DL algorithm. Comparing with the steepest descent algorithm and conjugate gradient method of BP neural network, the convergence speed of DL algorithm is higher than them in the inversion coefficient experiment of the equation. And its accuracy is similar to that of conjugate gradient method, but much better than that of steepest descent algorithm. In the experiment of Chinese text sentiment analysis, the precision, recall and F1 values of DL-BP are better than those of SD-BP and CG-BP. Based on DL-BP model, the early warning platform of teenager depression tendency is designed in this paper. It is a design with good stability, reliability and extensibility.

articleTitle: The Application of Three-Dimensional Reconstruction Technology in Assisted Orthodontics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: 3D reconstruction technology is the basis for the use of virtual reality technology to achieve a complete simulation of the virtual reality world. Therefore, 3D reconstruction technology has always been regarded as the main goal of research in emerging technology fields such as virtual reality. The advanced virtual reality technology is widely used in the correction treatment simulation process, and the correction treatment plan can be designed through intuitive diagnosis and analysis, so that patients and physicians to have an intuitive understanding of the corrective effects they have achieved before the formal start of treatment, which has considerable practical value. This article mainly focuses on the application of 3D modeling in assisted orthodontics. It has a simple understanding of the methods of oral modeling based on relevant data, and then summarizes the specific application of 3D reconstruction technology in orthodontics. In order to further understand the application of 3D technology in dentistry, this article carried out 3D modeling of the oral cavity. Through the modeling of the oral cavity, the difficulties in the application of 3D technology were discovered. Finally, the problems in the modeling process were monitored by experiments, and the experimental results obtained, the first group the average relative measurement accuracy of patients is 1.713%, the second group of patients is 1.690%, and the average relative measurement accuracy corresponding to the previous section is 4.430% and 4.114% (the relative value of the measurement is lower), the accuracy value (means the higher the accuracy).

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Key Mission Model Based on Association Relationship
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of real-time systems in terms of cost, size, power consumption, etc., the Mixed-Criticality System (MCS) integrates real-time applications with different key levels into a unified hardware platform to achieve coexistence and interaction. In the research of hybrid key-level scheduling, the current main consideration is the hybrid key task model and task graph model that are independent of each other. For the hybrid key task model that considers both the relationship between tasks and the periodicity and criticality of tasks, the current research is almost no. In view of this, this paper constructs a mixed-critical task model (Mixed-Criticality Task Model with Dependance, D-MCTM) based on the mixed-critical task model, and proposes a key factor based on the remaining window for the characteristics of the model advantage scheduling algorithm (Priority Scheduling Method based on Remaining Window, W-PCM).

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Based on SAS-Net Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Facial expression recognition has long been a challenging task in the computer field. Most of the existing facial expression recognition methods are the extraction of facial features, but these methods emphasize that the neural network should pay attention to some key features of the expression, such as eyes, nose, and mouth. These methods ignore some minor features that also affect expression recognition, such as facial texture and other features. This paper proposes an efficient Shuffle Attention Supplement (SAS)-Net attention module to solve some minor facial feature extraction problems. SAS-Net mainly combines the feature map before entering the SAS attention module and the attention feature map formed after aggregation of the submodules in the SAS attention module. This method makes the feature map serves as an information supplement to the feature map aggregated by the sub-modules of the SAS attention module, and strengthens the connection with the minor features of the feature map instead of only focusing on the salient features. This paper will combine the ResNet network with SAS attention module and ResNet network with Shuffle Attention (SA) module to experiment on the CK+ dataset, with the accuracy of 98.9836%. The results indicate that the proposed method has the potential to improve the performance of facial expression recognition.

articleTitle: Application Research of Detection Based on Frequency Electric Perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Different rocks have different electrical conductivity, and common rocks in coal measures often show different resistivity values. The vertical lithology change of coal measures shows the increase or decrease of resistivity. Along the direction of formation lithology change is generally small, show the resistivity is relatively uniform. When the coal measure is stable, the change law of vertical resistivity is basically the same, and the conductivity is relatively balanced in the direction of bedding. When there are water-filled cracks in coal measure sandstone, or the broken zone is water-bearing due to the fault cutting, there are obvious electrical differences between the structure and surrounding rock due to the good electrical conductivity of water body. After grouting reinforcement of water-filled crack or fracture zone, the original low resistance area will become secondary low or high resistance to a certain extent. In this paper, based on the regional data of mine and the hydro geological data of the existing limestone aquifer in the mine field, the water enrichment of the roof and floor of the workspace was detected by using the Frequency Electric Perspective before the workspace extraction. Through experimental testing, the final research results were applied to the actual detection, and the satisfactory results were obtained.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Decimal Network DDNS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Internet domain name is consists of characters, numbers, or both of them. when a client access to a website, it first send a request to local domain name server (DNS), if there is no record, local DNS request to higher authorities, until the root name servers, and get the correct record after return to local, and the cache to the local server, the process logic is complex. It's expensive in time and space. Decimal Network digital domain name system(DDNS) can directly find the target network terminal through the routing rules, without the need for domain name resolution and other conversion process, and then quickly establish the connection, reducing the scale of routing table of each forwarding node in the network, thus saving huge time and space costs. This paper introduces the concept of digital domain name system, the structure of digital domain name system, the grammar and extension of digital domain name system, the mapping of digital domain name system and IP address, and the resource record in digital domain name system. It will show the characteristics and advantages of digital domain name in a more comprehensive and detailed way.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring System of Materials Subject Laboratory Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In view of the situation that may cause flammable gas, harmful gas, smoke leakage and other damage to the health of scientific research personnel and the temperature and pressure in the experimental instrument exceed the upper limit of danger during the operation of the university materials subject laboratory, research and development Based on LAN, 4G, 5G materials subject laboratory intelligent IoT monitoring system, it is divided into four layers from bottom to top: perception execution layer, control service layer, transmission network layer, terminal application layer. After real-time measurement of abnormal environmental parameters, the IoT system automatically warns and regulates the drive exhaust fan to ensure the health of the experimental scientific research personnel. In addition, it monitors the temperature and pressure during the experiment. Once the limit is exceeded, it automatically drives the actuator to prevent fires, explosions and other accidents.

articleTitle: Research on Thrust Fluctuation of Linear Motor with Trapezoidal Halbach Pole
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Air core permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (ACPMLSM) with new permanent magnet structure was developed, and its key structural parameters were optimized to solve the problem of thrust and thrust fluctuation. Firstly, A new type of magnetic pole structure with trapezoidal Halbach arrangement is proposed. Then, the equivalent magnetization method is used to establish the mathematical model of the motor. The analytical formulas of motor magnetic field are derived respectively. Analyzed influence of polar-arc coefficient αρ, pole-height coefficient <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex>, air gap height coefficient <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\gamma$</tex> single side width factor of winding <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\chi$</tex> on thrust and thrust fluctuation. Finally, through the trial production of the prototype and the physical experiment of the motor under two working conditions, the effectiveness of the motor designed by the new type of pole array to restrain the thrust fluctuation is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Driving Cycle Synthesis Technology Based on Improved K-Means Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the initial clustering center has a great influence on the clustering results when the traditional clustering algorithm is constructed, an improved k-means clustering algorithm (Grid-K-means) is proposed, which uses grid density to determine the initial clustering center. Firstly, the original data is preprocessed by discrete Fourier transform, and the kinematic segments are divided and the eigenvalues of each segment are calculated by the short journey method, then the dimension of the characteristic parameter matrix is reduced by principal component analysis, and the three principal components obtained by principal component analysis are grouped into three categories by the improved k-means clustering algorithm. Then the representative kinematics fragments are selected from all kinds of segment libraries to synthesize the final vehicle driving conditions. The experimental results show that the average relative error of all the characteristic parameters of the driving condition constructed by the proposed method is only 2.86%, and the fitting degree of the driving condition is higher, which can more comprehensively reflect the running state of the actual vehicle.

articleTitle: Research on Video Classification Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: At present, the video classification is a challenging computer vision problem, and there are few researches in this field. For ordinary image video which contains many uncertain factors such as complex background and illumination changes. However, human skeleton image video has the advantages of simple content and less redundant information. But for such a simple video, classification is also difficult. With the development of deep learning, this paper combines the method of deep learning to detect and classify human skeleton behavior. The purpose of this study is to help researchers to label large-scale bone behavior data, reduce the pressure of follow-up research, and it can expand to the field of short video classification in the future. After video preprocessing operations such as frame and image down-sampling, the processed data is input into the model for convolution. The next is to extract frame sequence features through LSTM layer. Finally, the full connection is performed to output the probability of classification labels. This method has high accuracy in classifying human skeleton behavior.

articleTitle: Research of Boost Converter Sliding Mode Control Method Based on Exponential Reaching Law
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Due to the nonlinear structure of boost converter, the traditional PI controller can ensure the boost converter to work stably near the rated point, and achieve good dynamic and steady-state performance. When the working state of boost converter deviates greatly from the rated point, its stability cannot be guaranteed. Therefore, in order to solve the problem that the dynamic performance and stability of boost converter are insufficient when it deviates from the rated working state, the mathematical model of third-order sliding mode controller is established by adding voltage dynamic error state variable on the basis of second-order sliding mode boost converter. The exponential reaching law is applied to the third-order sliding mode controller, which can effectively reduce the overshoot in the start-up phase; when the input voltage changes suddenly, the load has strong robustness. The paper built the Simulink module, and through the Matlab/Simulink, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Internal Control Evaluation of Small and Micro Enterprises' Sales Process Based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The identification of internal control defects is an important basis for judging whether an enterprise's internal control is effective, and an important part of internal control evaluation. This study applies fuzzy neural network technology to the identification of defects in internal control sales, discusses the establishment of an internal control defect identification model to realize the identification and diagnosis of internal control defects in the company's sales process, and solves the problem that the current defect identification is overly dependent on the professionalism and judgment of the evaluators and is mainly diagnosed after the fact, leading to lack of identification and early warning during the incident. This article provides a feasible path for the research and development of the automatic identification and tracking of internal control defects in the sales process of enterprises, and also provides an example for the discussion of the combination of artificial intelligence and internal control.

articleTitle: Research on Fitness Action Evaluation System Based on Skeleton
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In recent years, with the promotion of the concept of sports to gain health, the cause of national fitness has stepped into the fast lane of development. However, for ordinary fitness people, due to the lack of corresponding supervision and evaluation feedback, resulting in long-term inaccurate or even wrong fitness process. Therefore, this paper designs and implements a skeleton based fitness action evaluation system. Firstly, open pose algorithm is applied to extract the skeleton nodes of each frame in the video, and then the extracted data is prepossessed by key node alignment, skeleton node balancing and other technologies. Then the skeleton nodes are used to evaluate the action duration, speed and scale. Finally, the evaluation model is established, The skeleton node is used to calculate the duration, speed and standard degree of the action, and the standard degree of the action is divided into three grades: excellent and poor, so as to guide the standardization of the trainer's action.

articleTitle: An Improved Group Mobility Model Suitable for Tactical Subnet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The mobility model of nodes plays an important role in affecting the quality of the tactical subnet. The unique characteristics of the tactical subnet may weaken the significance of research on the common mobility model. In this paper, firstly, we make a careful analysis and a simulation of the Random Waypoint Mobility Model (RWP) and the Reference Point Group Mobility Model (RPGM). Subsequently, according to the characteristics of the tactical task and the fact that the mobile nodes do not always move blindly along a random or fixed path, we propose a new group mobility model named Probabilistic Reference Point Group Mobility Model (p-RPGM). Finally, taking a tactical team as an example, the above three mobility models are simulated and compared based on OPNET simulation software, to reveal the influence of different mobile behaviors of nodes on network performance.

articleTitle: Research on Affective Computing Based on Self-Awareness
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Emotion is a kind of psychological activity that accompanies human beings. Emotion plays an important role in high-level cognitive behavior, such as decision making and learning. The goal of affective computing is to give computers the ability to perceive, understand, and express emotions. With the introduction of affective computing technology, agents have the ability to simulate and humanoid emotions. Based on self-consciousness of emotion computing in intelligent model (AORBCO), analysis of the current development and problems of emotion computing, is proposed based on self-awareness of emotion computing, the basic idea of emotional calculation method is given, and the emotional knowledge base is established, using knowledge weight change and updating knowledge base Ebbinghaus's law. Finally, the emotional calculation of Ego in AORBCO model is realized.

articleTitle: Biomimetic Sandwich Structures Optimization Under Graph-Based Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: This article described a two-step structure layout grow method for a cellular reinforced hybrid sandwich structures design with CFRP face sheets. In the first step a ground structure method is applied to get the initial structure topology data and a homogenize operation is taken to distribute the material to the base mesh grid centroid. In the second step, a bionic graph-based topology method which like the cell division is present to make the layout automatically grow. And for the optimization process, an evolution method of genetic algorithm is used to get the optimize result from the varied feasible solutions. A comparison between the pure honeycomb core sandwich and ortho-grid core honeycomb sandwich are taken which reflect a high performance by our method in the gird stiffener topology design.

articleTitle: Optimal Design and Performance Analysis of a New-Type Linear Oscillatory Motor with Three Divided Moving Body
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problems such as the electromagnetic thrust is too small and the output of electromagnetic thrust is not stable for the existing permanent magnet linear oscillation motor, A new type of permanent magnet linear oscillation motor with three divided moving body was proposed. By analyzing the working principle of permanent magnet linear oscillation motor, the preliminary design of motor structure was carried out. The simulation results show that the structural parameters such as the height of permanent magnet, the length of the secondary permanent magnet, the height of the air gap and the thickness of the inner stator core have great influence on the electromagnetic thrust. Through the optimization design of motor parameters, a new type of three divided moving body permanent magnet linear oscillation motor with large electromagnetic thrust and stable operation was obtained. After optimization, the electromagnetic thrust changes sinusoidally, and the maximum electromagnetic thrust was greatly improved. A new PMLOM control system was built, and the static force was measured.

articleTitle: Analysis of Computer Network Economy and Trade Form
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, the network almost covers most of the world, which makes the social economy and trade form have a subversive change, but also to our lives and work have brought a greater impact. Starting with the concept and characteristics of computer network economy, this paper expounds that computer network has changed the theory of economic growth, optimized the structure of economic industry and intensified the competition of market economy, this paper forecasts the development trend of computer network economy towards sharing economy and virtual shopping, and analyzes the influence of computer network on trade forms.

articleTitle: Information Protection of International Students Based on Network Security
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With China's overall national strength, the education of studying in China has entered a period of rapid development, and China has become one of the important destination countries for international student mobility. With political stability, rapid economic development, and continuous improvement in the quality of higher education, the educational value of studying in China is increasingly recognized by international students. International students study and live in the same way as domestic students. While the development of the Internet has brought convenience to people, it has also created many security risks. How to protect the information security of international students is the focus of this paper. This paper introduces the classification, characteristics and security risks of international students' personal information. In order to protect the private data of international students from being leaked, filtering rules are set in the campus network through WinRoute firewall to effectively prevent information from being leaked, tampered or deleted, which can be used for reference by other universities.

articleTitle: Design of Mobile Application Lifecycle Security Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Massive mobile app brings convenience to our work and life, at the same time, it also brings new security threats. Data leakage, property loss and other events caused by mobile applications often occur. According to the development status of various security services for mobile applications, this paper studies the current mainstream mobile application security detection and monitoring technology. Based on the concept of life cycle management in software industry, a variety of security concepts and technologies are reasonably integrated into each stage of mobile application life cycle, and a mobile application life cycle management platform with comprehensive security functions and multi system cooperation is designed and constructed.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Process Monitoring Equipment for Pole-Holding and Tower Assembly Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Big data technology plays a very important role in the monitoring process of pole-mounted towers. Based on big data technology, this article discusses the impact of big data on pole-holding towers and the development and application of pole-holding tower monitoring equipment, expounds the key technologies of big data in process monitoring, and real-time monitoring of the operating status of process equipment. It will analyze and process according to different types of test results. The final test results show that, compared with the traditional MSPCA technology, the improved MSPCA has significantly improved the missed detection rate and detection delay of monitoring equipment, achieved the expected effect, and met the requirements of project construction.

articleTitle: Design of Photodetector Test System Based on Visual Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of slow response sensitivity, low accuracy and relying on manual detection of photoelectric detection system, an automatic test system of photoelectric detector was proposed. The system uses CCD visual identification and grid scanning to replace manual center alignment and test point positioning, uses signal source, oscilloscope, electronic signal processing circuit, computer monitoring software to realize automatic detection, and generates test report. The system can effectively reduce the labor intensity and improve the precision of the test. The effectiveness of the system is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Improved Sine Cosine Optimization Algorithm Based on Hybrid Mutation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The algorithm of sine and cosine has some problems such as premature convergence, low accuracy and slow speed for solving high-dimensional functions. This paper proposes an improved sine and cosine algorithm based on hybrid mutation strategy. Firstly, the initial population was generated by the chaotic initialization strategy to improve the diversity of the initial population. Secondly, the hybrid mutation is used to perturb the population, which improves the convergence precision of the algorithm and enhances the ability to jump out of the local optimum. Finally, the boundary control strategy is designed to regenerate the population beyond the boundary. Ten standard test functions are analyzed by numerical simulation and compared with other algorithms to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. The improved sine and cosine algorithm proposed in this paper is applied to pressure vessel design problems to verify the effectiveness of the improved algorithm in solving practical problems.

articleTitle: The Application of SDN in Range Command and Control Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The command and control network in the range plays is aimed at realizing the interconnection between the front-end access layer and the back-end application layer, and the transmission and interaction of the testing information including data, images, and audio. With the popularization of the regional collaborative networking for testing, the operational efficiency of the command and control network in the range has become a pivotal factor. However, the command and the control network in the range is still restricted to the traditional network architecture, thus its poor flexibility and insufficient control remain restraining factors for high-quality services at present, so the exploration of the feasibility and potentiality of new technologies or methods which can be applied in the command and control network in the range is necessary. Starting with the concept and architecture of SDN, this paper summarized its major technological features and application advantages in the communication network. Combined with the business requirements of the range command and control network, the typical application scenario and scheme was presented, and then the workflow of the SDN technology applied was clarified, so as to provide a new idea for the next stage in the process of the integrated testing in the range.

articleTitle: Progressive Damage Analysis of CFRP Laminates Under Three-Point Bending Load
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In this paper, a new progressive damage model with a set of progressive stiffness degradation rules was developed. This model combined the three-dimensional Hashin failure criteria with the cohesive zone method to investigate the mechanical behavior of CFRP composites under quasi-static bending loads. A cross-ply([0/90]4s) laminate made of pre-preg Carbon Fibre Reinforced Plastic (CFRP) composites was manufactured and tested under quasi-static bending loads. The initiation, evolution and interaction of composite damage were captured. The model was implemented in the finite element code to predict typical failure modes of composite materials. The load-deflection curve of the CFRP composite laminate under the three-point bending load was obtained by finite element simulation. The curve of the degradation stage after the ultimate load and the failure mode of the laminate fitted the test results consistently.

articleTitle: Research on Online Teaching Satisfaction Based on Big Data and COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Under the background of COVID-19, online teaching has become the focus of the whole society. Based on this, this paper takes Shaanxi higher vocational colleges of finance and economics as the research object and conducts a questionnaire survey on the satisfaction of online teaching during the epidemic period. The results show that the offline students' homework performance, final exam scores and teaching satisfaction are better than the online students. Therefore, this paper proposes to enhance the interaction between teachers and students, stimulate the motivation of students; Provide environmental support and strengthen learning motivation; Improve the online course design to reduce students' learning pressure. This study not only helps to solve the urgent needs of online teaching, but also provides a reference path for the healthy and orderly development of online teaching in the new era.

Author Keywords: Shaanxi Higher Vocational Finance and Economics Colleges

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Network Course Platform Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: As an important part of education, curriculum construction is always the focus of teaching quality in colleges and universities. This study mainly discusses the construction of cloud platform for online courses of college pop singing majors in the era of big data. The user center module mainly involves user WeChat login, user view personal information, user view their study record and consumption record. Data mining model management provides users with simple and interactive operation interface to create mining model, which enables users to create mining simply and clearly and manage it conveniently. Users can use offline caching to download videos of the courses they need to study, instead of using up network or mobile data multiple times. In the final results, 26 students in the experimental group scored in the excellent range, compared with 22 students in the control group. This study is helpful to promote the development of popular singing major in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Design of a Multi-Domain Joint Combat Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the concept of multi-domain joint combat, the future joint combat simulation system will develop in the direction of trans-military species and trans-regional. In response to the problem that the existing combat simulation system can hardly guarantee the security and reliability of data interaction in multi-domain joint combat simulation, a blockchain-based multi-domain joint combat simulation system framework is constructed. The corresponding technical solutions are given for the data layer, network layer, consensus layer, contract layer and application layer of the system. The block storage format of the data layer, the content of the simulation data to be packaged and the verification method during transmission are mainly studied. Proposed a hybrid consensus mechanism based on traditional deterministic consensus algorithm with high availability and high fault tolerance. A smart contract for the joint combat simulation process and a smart contract for the secondary processing of simulation data are designed. Finally, the workflow of the whole system is illustrated by a case study.

articleTitle: Overview of Oral Interventional Surgery Robot Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Oral interventional surgery robots can assist doctors to remotely control mobile phones to perform surgery, reduce radiation hazards, improve surgery accuracy, and shorten surgery time. It has become a research focus of medical robots. This article introduces the positioning system of dental implant interventional surgery robot designed by domestic and foreign research institutions in recent years. Analyze key positioning technologies such as mobile phone equipment, electromagnetic navigation, mechanical navigation, ultrasonic navigation, and optical navigation in the oral interventional surgery robot, clarify the significance of this technology in the oral interventional surgery robot system, and discuss the development trend of key technologies Finally, it lists the future research directions of the oral intervention surgery robot positioning system. This article can enable researchers to understand the structure of the positioning system of the oral interventional surgery robot, grasp the development status of key technologies, and provide references for future research directions.

articleTitle: Implementation of A Python-Based Website Voting Program
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the advent of the big data era, relying only on primitive manual operations will not be able to efficiently manage the large amount of information involved in voting activities. Voting event organizers can only obtain data manually, and it is difficult to ensure the timeliness and accuracy of the data. The purpose of this article is to research and analyze the implementation of the Python-based website voting program. This article first provides an overview of the basic theory of Python, and then extends it. The core technology is based on the problems and shortcomings of the current voting program in our country, and the design and research of the Python-based website voting program is carried out. This paper systematically expounds the target design, module design and database design of the voting program, and uses comparative analysis, observation and other research methods to research, analyze and implement the Python-based website voting program. Experimental research shows that compared with traditional voting websites, Python-based website voting programs have higher accuracy and better performance.

articleTitle: Personalized Film and Television Recommendation System Based on Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The emergence of big data platforms has alleviated the restrictions of space and time on people's enjoyment of music information services. The need to improve user experience has become very urgent. One of the effective solutions to information overload is the recommendation system, which can help people discover interesting content from complex information. Therefore, the purpose of this article is to study a personalized film and television recommendation system based on a big data platform. This article first introduces the core technology of big data through an overview of the basic theory of big data. And combined with the traditional film and television recommendation method, analyze the existing problems and shortcomings, and analyze and discuss it with the core technology of big data. This article systematically expounds the overall process, system composition design and algorithm analysis of the personalized film and television recommendation system based on the big data platform. Experimental research shows that the algorithm proposed in this paper is better than the traditional User-basedCF strategy and Item-basedCF strategy under the same number of movies recommended by Hit-rate.

articleTitle: Research on BP Decoding of Polar Codes Aided by Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In recent years, polar codes under deep learning have become a research hotspot because of their outstanding decoding performance. The neural network-based polar codes confidence propagation decoding algorithm can improve the decoding performance significantly, but the computational complexity and delay of the neural network-based polar codes confidence propagation decoding algorithm still need to be improved. In this paper, the theory of polar codes coding and the traditional polar codes confidence propagation decoding algorithm are introduced. The polar codes confidence propagation decoding algorithm based on deep neural network and recurrent neural network and the advantages and disadvantages of different decoding algorithms are mainly discussed, and the computational complexity of these algorithms is analyzed. According to the offset minimum sum approximation and scaling offset minimum sum approximation, the polar codes confidence propagation decoding algorithm based on recurrent neural network is optimized. Simulation results show that, compared with the traditional polar codes confidence propagation decoding algorithm, the decoding algorithm improves the decoding performance, reduces the computational complexity and reduces the iteration times of the algorithm. Compared with the polar codes confidence propagation decoding algorithm based on deep neural network and recurrent neural network, the multiplication and memory overhead of the algorithm are greatly reduced while the decoding performance of the algorithm is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Prediction of Strip Width in Roughing-Mill Group Based on PSO-LSSVM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy of width prediction based on mechanism model in Roughing Mills of Hot Rolling Mills (RMHRM), this paper proposes a method of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to optimize Support Vector Machine (SVM) prediction model parameters, in order to realize the real-time prediction of the strip width change in the rough rolling mill. Firstly, select input variables which are highly correlated with the width of the rough rolled strip, and build the Least Square Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) width prediction model. Secondly, this paper uses the PSO algorithm to optimize the kernel function parameters of LSSVM. Finally, take the 2050-model RMHRM in Shanghai as an example, and the on-site measured sample data is used for training and verification the model. Compared with traditional model prediction results, the prediction method of PSO-LSSVM is more effective.

Author Keywords: Roughing Mills of Hot Rolling Mills (RMHRM)
